title: The Unchosen Choice Reflected

features.name: the path-ghost
features.desc-on-touch: you see the ridge's own reflection, walking itself—a thin parallel line that matches your ridge but chosen the other way. the file it holds is the decision you never made, still occurring.

features.name: the photographic break
features.desc-on-touch: a portrait that has divided itself down the middle—one side shows the ridge as it stands, the other the ridge as it would have been. the corruption has not resolved which is which.

features.name: the twin calculation
features.desc-on-touch: a sensor on both ridges reading the same pressure at the same time, yet returning different numbers. the echo is exact but inverted.

features.name: the reversed landmark
features.desc-on-touch: a rock formation you passed on the way in, now standing on the other side of the ridge, unchanged but in reflection. you are circling back to a place you have not yet left.

features.name: the inscription-panel
features.desc-on-touch: carved twice, slightly different each time—one reads as if you came here, the other as if you did not. both are equally worn.

inscription: your choice stands here as a path you can still choose not to walk
